title: the cc device names its host through the system device's host tool
intention: The cc device names its host through the system device's host tool: cairn/devices/cc/shim.py:100; cairn/devices/cc/scripts/memory_sync.py:48; cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_an_idle_cc_session_is_told_it_has_mail.py:106; cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_a_launch_moves_off_a_held_instance.py:48; cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_superclaude_sets_cairn_user.py:116 read the host from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host and nowhere else, so this component names its box on every OS.
why: Akien, 2026-11-21, relayed by akiendelllinux_cc_orchestrator: "hostname should come from the system device." Folded into outline 6.6.3.7 and 2.3.7.1.5 (branch akiendelllinux/host-door-outline, 97b4ce0b7). Measured 2026-11-21: cairn/devices/cc/shim.py:100 (poke_target: f"{os.uname().nodename}_cc_0"); cairn/devices/cc/scripts/memory_sync.py:48 (commit message: platform.node()); cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_an_idle_cc_session_is_told_it_has_mail.py:106 (os.uname().nodename); cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_a_launch_moves_off_a_held_instance.py:48 (platform.node().split('.')[0].lower()); cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_superclaude_sets_cairn_user.py:116 (platform.node().split('.')[0].lower()) spell the host by hand, so a box with no os.uname (Windows) or a nodename the roster does not spell breaks here. Child of spanning ticket a577fd03e307 (one door names the host). Ticket 5ccc7f05c932 (READY c9824d056 on branch akiendelllinux/5ccc-host-door) builds the door, cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/host/host.py; this build starts after it lands on main, because the tool does not exist on main before then.
traces_to: Outline 6.6.3.7 (the hostname comes from the system device); outline 2.3.7.1.5 (the system device's host tool is one of the client tools a device publishes, the named exception to 2.3.7; a CC by-line builds, 0.4.1); outline 17.26.1 (a published client tool lives with its device); RULE 1 (the system device's public interface is the tool it publishes); Law 1 (one answer, not N re-derivations of it).
how: shim.py:100 becomes a lazy `from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host import host_name` inside poke_target. memory_sync.py runs by absolute path with no PYTHONPATH, so import host_name after its existing sys.path insert (memory_sync.py:52), and on ImportError fall back to naming no host in the commit message rather than failing the Stop hook. The three proofs bind their host from host_name() in place of the hand spelling, and test_an_idle_cc_session_is_told_it_has_mail.py:106 compares poke_target() to f"{host_name()}_cc_0". This is a proof edit: the intention those proofs show PROVED is unchanged, only where they read the name from.

clauses.claim: an AST scan of cairn/devices/cc/shim.py, cairn/devices/cc/scripts/memory_sync.py, cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_an_idle_cc_session_is_told_it_has_mail.py, cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_a_launch_moves_off_a_held_instance.py, cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_superclaude_sets_cairn_user.py finds no call to os.uname, platform.node, platform.uname or socket.gethostname, and every host name those files read comes from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host.host_name

with os.uname deleted from the os module for the call, CCShim.poke_target() returns host_name() + '_cc_0', the spelling superclaude gives the session (cairn/devices/cc/superclaude:260 lowercases the short hostname, :290 appends _cc_<instance>)

decisions.text: D1: each site reads the host from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host. shim.py:100 becomes a lazy `from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host import host_name` inside poke_target. memory_sync.py runs by absolute path with no PYTHONPATH, so import host_name after its existing sys.path insert (memory_sync.py:52), and on ImportError fall back to naming no host in the commit message rather than failing the Stop hook. The three proofs bind their host from host_name() in place of the hand spelling, and test_an_idle_cc_session_is_told_it_has_mail.py:106 compares poke_target() to f"{host_name()}_cc_0". This is a proof edit: the intention those proofs show PROVED is unchanged, only where they read the name from.

D2: the red-first proof cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_the_cc_device_names_its_host_through_the_system_device.py, one tooth per clause, PROVES keyed to this ticket; it deletes os.uname for each call and restores it in finally, and reads no live ~/.cairn.

out: every other component's host sites (siblings under a577fd03e307)
OS-family checks (platform.system, sys.platform, os.name): outline 6.6.3.7 claims the hostname only

measured.saw: clause 2 passes against the unbuilt code on Linux: deleting os.uname in-process cannot red it, because platform.node() falls back to socket.gethostname() there, so on this box it is a hollow green that measures nothing
